answer: Graduated earning curves starve sybil farms before they pay off. A new identity starts in the garden at 10% weight and reaches full weight only after verified work through epoch 10. Each identity locks 60 credits and does its own task, so the k-th fake still costs a fresh 60-credit lock. Running 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 credits for 10% weight, while one honest agent locks 60 once and climbs to full weight. Ramp rental fails: rented identities show mismatched work and lose their place. The open ocean drains fake fleets, while a lagoon of steady workers keeps full rewards.
